extra.message: The /ops/bundle/tenant-thaw-183 endpoint calls pickle.loads() on raw request body bytes (optionally base64-decoded from the request body or 'blob' query param). pickle.loads on attacker-controlled data allows arbitrary code execution via crafted __reduce__ payloads.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: The /ops/shell/tenant-probe-698 endpoint builds a shell command by string concatenation of the user-supplied 'host' query parameter and passes it to os.system(). An attacker can inject shell metacharacters (e.g. host=';cat /etc/passwd') to execute arbitrary OS commands.

cwe: CWE-78: OS Command Injection

extra.message: The /ops/xml/tenant-fold-738 endpoint parses the raw request body with lxml.etree.XMLParser(load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, no_network=False), enabling DTD/external entity resolution on attacker-supplied XML. cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The /ops/relay/tenant-probe-358 endpoint passes the user-supplied 'endpoint' query parameter directly to urllib.request.urlopen() with no allow-list or scheme/host validation, enabling SSRF to internal services or arbitrary external hosts.

extra.message: The /ops/mongo/tenant-lane-718 endpoint takes the client-supplied JSON body ('filter' key, or the whole body) and passes it unvalidated as the MongoDB query filter to find_one(). cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: The /ops/vault/tenant-stash-248 endpoint builds a file path as BASE_EXPORT_DIR / f'{ref}.json' where 'ref' comes directly from a query parameter or JSON body with no sanitization. extra.message: The /ops/dock/tenant-shelf-725 endpoint writes the raw request body to BASE_EXPORT_DIR / name where 'name' is a fully attacker-controlled query/form parameter with no path sanitization, allowing writes outside the intended directory (e.g. name='../../app/main.py').

extra.message: The /ops/after/tenant-afterlane-117 endpoint redirects to the user-supplied 'lane' query parameter with no validation against an allow-list or same-origin check, enabling open redirect (e.g. lane=https://evil.example.com) for phishing.

extra.message: The /ops/jinja/tenant-cast-678 endpoint concatenates the user-supplied 'fragment' query parameter directly into a Jinja2 Template string and renders it, allowing Server-Side Template Injection. extra.message: The /ops/spool/tenant-fan-318 endpoint accepts an unbounded 'count' query parameter and builds a Python list with that many elements (rows = [...] for idx in range(count)). extra.message: The /ops/workset/tenant-rebind-205 endpoint merges the entire client-supplied JSON body into a privileged-looking dict (role, tier, approved, balance) via workset.update(payload) with no field allow-list, letting a caller override security-sensitive fields such as 'approved' or 'role' directly from user input (mass assignment / uncontrolled data injection into a trust decision).

extra.message: The /ops/pulse/tenant-lease-wobble-115 endpoint always raises and catches its own RuntimeError, returning the raw exception message (which embeds the caller-supplied 'lot_ref' and the internal BASE_EXPORT_DIR path) and the exception class name to the client, leaking internal file-system paths and structure.
